data.case_title: Car insurance: wildlife accident claim documents requested
data.title: Request for documents – wildlife accident claim (Wildunfall)
data.summary: Kfz-Versicherung Beispielsicher AG asks Bastian Musterquell to return the completed claim questionnaire together with a confirmation of the wildlife damage (Wildschadenbescheinigung) for the deer collision on 9 November 2026, within 13 working days of the letter's date, to process the partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) claim under claim number KS-26-1109-218.
data.explanation: Your car insurer needs proof of the wildlife collision (a confirmation from the hunting lessee or the police) and the enclosed claim questionnaire, filled in and returned, before it can process your partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) claim. Send both documents back by the deadline shown in the app, which is calculated from the letter's date. If you miss it, the insurer may delay or be unable to settle your claim, so it is worth sending the documents as soon as you have them.
